issues.issue: Whether the principal claimant's account of the 2008 skinhead attack and police response is credible
issues.applicant_position: Counsel submits the principal claimant's evidence is credible and supports his claim.
issues.result_text: Panel finds the 2008 skinhead attack did not occur or was invented; adverse credibility finding.

issues.issue: Whether Roma discrimination in the Czech Republic amounts to persecution with a Convention nexus
issues.applicant_position: Counsel argues claimants face persecution based on race, nationality or social group as ethnic Romani.
issues.result_text: Panel disagrees with the nexus submission; treatment does not reach the level of persecution.

issues.issue: Whether Czech state protection is adequate and the presumption is rebutted
issues.result_text: Claimants have not given clear and convincing evidence that state protection would be unavailable.

issues.issue: Whether denial of health care to Roma amounts to persecution under IRPA s.97(1)(b)(iv)
issues.applicant_position: Counsel says Czech health care persecutes Roma; s.97(1)(b)(iv) does not apply and Roma life expectancy is lower.
issues.result_text: Shorter Roma lifespan not due to persecutory denial of care; 77% of Roma consider care adequate.
